t.description: A `Tensor` or `IndexedSlices`. This must be a floating point type.

clip_norm.description: A 0-D (scalar) `Tensor` > 0. A maximum clipping value, also floating point. Note: If a negative clip_norm is provided, it will be treated as zero.
constraints: If a negative clip_norm is provided, it will be treated as zero.

axes.description: A 1-D (vector) `Tensor` of type int32 containing the dimensions to use for computing the L2-norm. If `None` (the default), uses all dimensions.

constraints: TypeError: If dtype of the input is not a floating point
